script_text: Aries, Mars in Aries, your ruling planet, exposes the hidden pattern, so your Fire sign needs strategy. Monday shines with the Gemini New Moon in your 3rd House, unlocking messages, and Tuesday favors love as Venus trines Saturn from Pisces in your 12th House. Wednesday is rough: Mercury squares Uranus between your 5th and 2nd Houses, so a flashy money text can mislead. Thursday is the turning point, when Mercury stations retrograde in Leo in your 5th House, rewriting a pitch, romance, or launch. Friday improves as Venus sextiles Jupiter from Cancer in your 4th House, favoring a contract or lease. Sunday's Sun enters Cancer in your 4th House, pulling the weekend toward family, property, healing, and rest. Wednesday is your power day: you catch the money glitch first. Worst day: Thursday, because Mercury retrograde exposes the overpromise. Keep receipts, Aries. Follow for daily updates.
